people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Nabal
people.line: Wealthy Carmelite; husband of Abigail. He was known for foolishness.

translations.web: David heard in the wilderness that Nabal was shearing his sheep.
translations.bsb: While David was in the wilderness, he heard that Nabal was shearing sheep.
translations.kjv: And David heard in the wilderness that Nabal did shear his sheep.
translations.asv: And David heard in the wilderness that Nabal was shearing his sheep.
